title: SIEVE: Overcoming Topological Obstruction in Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21087v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We identify a theoretical incompatibility between 3D point cloud masked autoencoding and SE(3)-equivariant networks. We prove that standard masking triggers a topological collapse, effectively forcing the model to hallucinate orientation without a reference frame. To resolve this, we introduce SIEVE (Scalar Invariant Extraction Via Equivariance), an SE(3)-equivariant self-supervised framework that compresses point cloud geometry into invariant scalar embeddings. At its core is the spherical projection mask, which preserves global pose while obfuscating local semantics, sidestepping the obstruction by construction. Experiments confirm that SIEVE circumvents the predicted collapse where constant and noise masks fail. On downstream point cloud tasks, the resulting embeddings improve over coordinate-based baselines and hand-crafted geometric descriptors, with the largest gains on generalization to unseen shape categories.

translated_title: SIEVE：克服等变自监督学习中的拓扑障碍
translated_abstract: 我们揭示了3D点云掩码自编码与SE(3)等变网络之间的理论不兼容性。我们证明标准掩码会引发拓扑坍塌，实际上迫使模型在没有参考坐标系的情况下凭空猜测朝向。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SIEVE（Scalar Invariant Extraction Via Equivariance，基于等变性的标量不变量提取），这是一个SE(3)等变自监督框架，可将点云几何压缩为不变的标量嵌入。其核心是球面投影掩码，它在保留全局姿态的同时模糊局部语义，从构造上绕开了这一障碍。实验证实，SIEVE在常量掩码和噪声掩码失效的情况下成功规避了所预测的坍塌。在下游点云任务上，所得嵌入优于基于坐标的基线方法和手工设计的几何描述符，其中在对未见形状类别的泛化上提升最为显著。
tldr: 该论文发现3D点云掩码自编码与SE(3)等变网络间存在拓扑坍塌障碍，并提出SIEVE框架，利用球面投影掩码将点云几何压缩为不变标量嵌入，从构造上克服该障碍并在下游任务尤其是跨类别泛化上取得显著提升。
en_tdlr: SIEVE identifies a topological collapse in SE(3)-equivariant masked autoencoding of 3D point clouds and overcomes it via a spherical projection mask that compresses point cloud geometry into invariant scalar embeddings, yielding improved downstream performance and strongest gains in generalization to unseen shape categories.
